.
Select sessions will be live streamed through the CVENT Virtual Attendee Hub.
Discounted fees are available to active Signatories and Patrons of
the Groningen Declaration Network, and session speakers.
Active signatories are those who have paid their 2026 annual fee.
Not sure if your organisation is a signatory?
Click here to check
.
Apply to become a Signatory and Patron
to benefit from discounted registration fees, access to the GDN Video Library, GDN My Online Services, and more throughout the year. Becoming a signatory means a commitment to promote the aims of the Groningen Declaration Network.

Your Full Conference In-Person Registration Includes
Full access to the
three-day conference
from
October 20-22
.
Complimentary access to the
pre-conference half-day workshop on Decolonizing Recognition
on
October 19
(separate registration required;
limited spots available
)
.
Six refreshment breaks featuring
coffee, tea, and snacks
.
Three conference lunches.
Admission to the
Welcome Reception
on
October 20
, including drinks and canapés.
Access to the
Gala Dinner and Cultural Experience
at
Moya
and the
Botanical Gardens
, with drinks included.
Round-trip transportation to and from
Moya
provided by the conference’s designated transportation partner.
Group Bookings:
Get 10% off all registrants on groups of 3 or more. To register a group, select the “
Group discount: 10% off for groups of 3 or more
” button when you get to the
Registration Summary
page on the Registration Form. Add as many group members from your organization as you would like. The discount will apply automatically at payment.
Group discounts are only applicable to the Corporate Representative, Not-for-Profit Representative, Signatory, Patron and Session Speaker pricing rates.
Virtual Registration fees include:
Access to the Virtual Attendee Hub to view live streamed plenary sessions, select breakout sessions, Q&A participation, on demand access for up to 30 days after the annual meeting, virtual chat and networking with all delegates (onsite and virtual), and engagement with sponsors. As a virtual attendee you will be granted access to the Virtual Attendee Hub about a week before the event.
Conference App:
All
attendees will be granted access to the Virtual Attendee Hub about a week before the event.
Accompanying Guests:
Registered attendees are welcome to bring guests to the social functions at a cost.

Not-for-Profit Representative (non Signatory)
An attendee who from a not-for-profit organisation, educational institution or government agency.
Corporate Representative (non Signatory)
An attendee from a company or corporation.
In-Region Participant
An attendee who lives in Africa and is from a not-for-profit organization, a government institution, or a school.
Student
An attendee who is a student and currently undertaking study and who is not also in full time work.
